name: 定制包装（礼盒 / 彩盒 / 内托）
offer: We develop custom rigid gift boxes, folding cartons, fitted inserts and matching paper bags, from concept and physical sample to bulk order, shipped worldwide.
ideal_customers: skincare, cosmetics, fragrance, essential oil, soap and haircare brands
candle makers, home fragrance and home decor brands
jewelry, watches, scarves and fashion accessory brands
tea, coffee, chocolate, confectionery and specialty food gift brands
headphones, wearables, phone accessories and compact consumer electronics brands
stationery, museum shop, book gift set and corporate gift businesses
markets: USA, Canada, UK, Ireland, Germany, France, Netherlands, Nordics, Australia, New Zealand
exclude: marketplaces (Amazon/Etsy shops), giant corporations, resellers, packaging/printing companies
concept_library:
Structures (A and B must be different families; pick what genuinely suits THIS product, and surprise when it helps):
- magnetic flap rigid box (book-style lid, hidden magnets)
- lift-off lid rigid box (separate lid and base)
- shoulder-neck rigid box (lid sits on a visible inner collar)
- drawer / slide box (tray slides out of a sleeve, ribbon pull)
- double drawer or tiered drawer tower (two or three stacked drawers for sets)
- hinged keepsake box (attached lid, jewellery style)
- clamshell / book box with side magnetic closure that opens like a novel
- round / cylinder tube box (bottles, candles, rolled scarves)
- half-lid cylinder with a rotating or slide-up sleeve
- hexagon or octagon rigid box (faceted lid, sculptural shelf presence)
- double-door / opening-wings box (front doors swing open for a reveal)
- lift-up reveal box (pulling the lid raises the product on a platform or ribbon cradle)
- window box (clear die-cut window or frosted acetate panel)
- trunk / suitcase box with carry handle and clasp (gifting, travel kits)
- collapsible magnetic gift box (ships flat, snaps rigid; saves freight)
- pillow / cushion box (curved ends, small accessories)
- envelope or folio box (flat items, scarves, prints, cards)
- gable or tote-shaped carton with built-in handle
- folding carton, tuck end or auto-lock bottom (economical, flat-shipped)
- sleeve + tray carton (paperboard sleeve over a tray, colour-coded sleeves per variant)
- printed corrugated mailer box with interior print (DTC shipping, subscriptions)
- advent / calendar box with numbered doors (sets, sampler collections)
- display-ready box that converts into a stand or countertop display after opening
- reusable keepsake box designed for a second life (storage, jewellery dish, planter sleeve)
Inserts: EVA with fabric cover, molded pulp or fibre, paperboard die-cut, satin/velvet cradle, card dividers for sets, hidden compartment / false bottom, pull-tab lifting ribbon.
Finishes: soft-touch lamination, textured or recycled specialty paper, hot-foil, emboss/deboss, spot UV, ribbon pull, magnetic closure, edge painting, interior print, die-cut patterns.
design_guidance: Choose structures by product shape, fragility, unit count and how it is gifted, not by price. Match the customer's brand colours and mood from the photo and site. Each concept needs a fitted insert holding the product securely. Soft goods are folded plausibly.
email_extra: If you propose a folding carton or mailer box you may mention MOQ 1,000 pcs; never give prices, lead times, certifications or engineering approval. Concepts are for discussion and need sample validation.
subject_examples: two box ideas for your Rosewood bangle
cta_examples: If either fits, just reply A or B with a rough quantity and I'll send a unit price and sample timeline.

image.prompt:
Photorealistic premium packaging presentation, landscape, two packaging concepts side by side for the same product.

PRODUCT (keep it exactly like the reference photo - same shape, colours, label, proportions; do not redesign it): {product}. {count} shown inside each package.

LEFT - concept "A": {a_structure}. {a_visual}
RIGHT - concept "B": {b_structure}. {b_visual}

Both packages open at a three-quarter angle so the fitted insert holding the product is clearly visible; lids, sleeves and drawers physically consistent with their bases. The brand name "{brand}" appears once on each package as subtle foil or emboss, spelled exactly. No other words or logos on the packaging.

Small elegant serif letters "A" and "B" near the top of each half. Small footer text centred at the bottom: "{footer}".

Scene: {scene}. Soft natural daylight, gentle realistic shadows, high-end catalogue photography, clean composition, both concepts equally sized and fully in frame.

followup.body:
Hi {brand} team,

Just floating this back to the top of your inbox - happy to adapt either concept for {product}, or send a physical sample so you can feel the materials.

Would A or B be worth a quick quote?
